messages:
Maya: Quick sync on followups from last night's authz regression. Dropping action items I think we should own — pls ack or suggest tweaks.

Maya: ACTIONS:
- Token validation: add stricter TTL checks + unit tests. owner: Samir. ETA: 2026-04-02
- Permission fallback: ensure deny-by-default config. owner: Leah. ETA: 2026-04-05
- Audit logging: ensure request_id + user_id for all auth events. owner: Devon. ETA: 2026-03-30
- Secrets rotation playbook: validate automated rotation + runbook. owner: Maya + Ops. ETA: 2026-04-10

Samir: Ack. I can take token validation. I'll add tests and a canary rollout. plan: add new validator in authz middleware, and a regression test in CI. :thumbsup:

Leah: Ack. I want to make deny-by-default a feature flag so we can toggle. ETA looks ok, maybe +2 days. I'll update the ticket.

Devon: On audit logging — do we want structured JSON logs? I can add a schema and ensure logs ship to Splunk. pinging @sec-bot for retention policy.

sec-bot: Incident doc: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/1832456789> — remediation checklist created. Reminder set: /remind #incidents in 3 days to check progress.

Ops: We need to validate secret rotation in staging canary before prod. I'll schedule a run Wed morning and record steps.

Maya: Samir — please include a short eval harness for sample token tamper cases. Leah — can you add a test verifying policy default denies? Devon — link audit schema here when ready.

Samir: Will do. I'll push a branch with tests: `authz/token-ttl-guards` and request review.

Leah: Added ticket RED-4112, moved ETA to 2026-04-07. :calendar:

Devon: Drafting schema: `{"event":"auth_attempt","user_id": "...", "request_id":"..."}` will share link in thread.

Maya: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Fri standup. If any blocker, ping me. :eyes:
